text:
```yaml
name: Changelog Enforcer

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

permissions:
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changelog:
    name: Changelog Enforcer
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Enforce changelog
        uses: dangoslen/changelog-enforcer@v3
        with:
          changeLogPath: 'CHANGELOG.md'
          missingError: 'Please add a changelog entry to CHANGELOG.md under the "dev" section.'
          skipLabels: 'skip-changelog, documentation'
          requireChangeList: false
```
